question_policy: Four source-grounded positive questions, one unsupported request and one source-contradicting premise per paper; paired English/Korean questions stay together.
evaluation_policy: Freeze labels before baseline outputs. Tune only dev. Freeze candidate before evaluating held-out papers once. Opened holdout is regression data for subsequent changes.
scoring: Fact-alias coverage is a lexical diagnostic, not semantic accuracy. Human or curator content review reported separately. Neither citation location nor output contract proves a correct answer.
stop_rule: At most three development variants of the core selection strategy. Stop variants when no admissible improvement; do not tune on holdout.
